stories.title: Central Ohio teen advocates for DEFIANCE Act on Capitol Hill alongside Paris Hilton
stories.summary: “It made me feel like I was doing something to help girls that could be put into the position that I was," Elizabeth Cline said about her trip to D.C.

stories.title: 6 human trafficking victims recovered after raids at 3 Sandusky massage parlors, Ohio AG says
stories.summary: The Ohio Attorney General's Office says investigators also searched an Erie County apartment and a Cuyahoga County home, seizing cash, firearms and drugs.

stories.title: Cuyahoga County Sheriff's Department investigating inmate death at corrections center
stories.summary: According to the Cuyahoga County Sheriff's Department, the inmate was found unresponsive in the facility's medical pod at approximately 12:50 a.m.

stories.title: Cleveland Christmas Connection returns to I-X Center this weekend: Here’s what to expect
stories.summary: In addition to all the shopping, Hallmark Channel star Tyler Hynes will be making a special appearance at 1 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 20.

stories.title: Salvation Army Greater Cleveland needs 10,000 toys for annual Christmas campaign after fire destroys thousands: How you can help
stories.summary: Fans attending designated Cleveland Charge and Monsters games can donate new, unwrapped toys valued between $25 and $30.

stories.title: Barricade situation in Willoughby Hills ends with 'safe conclusion' overnight after suspect surrenders
